name: reasoning audit (final adjudication)

AUD1_adversarial.strongest_rejection_case: Kohn-2k_F/hexagonal-Fermi-nesting motivation is DECORATIVE: with per-head learnable wavevectors, gradient descent sets the kernel's spectral peaks and the physics analogy imposes no surviving constraint/bias/loss term. Strip the metaphor and GridFermi-PE reduces to a generic learnable multi-scale spectral PE — a crowded class (FoPE, LongRoPE, MEP 2403.17698, KERPLE, and esp. Wavelet-PE 2502.02004 with per-head learnable scale/shift).
AUD1_adversarial.residual_overclaim: QUEST transplanted as a LENGTH-GENERALIZATION mechanism, but its own evidence validates query-norm sharpness only for training-stability/robustness in VISION — off-domain; the chain never flagged this.

AUD2_holistic.filtering_evidence: Stage-distributed ~94% mortality; Stage 3 killed 5/8 (1 unanimous hallucination + 4 redundancy flips at 0.50 inter-checker disagreement); Stage 4 killed 2/3 trivial variants; ~80 adversarial prior-art queries; value assessors returned a DEFLATIONARY verdict. 0.50 disagreement + self-deflating value + 0/1071 predecessor base-rate = not rubber-stamping. Independent search reproduced the no-collision result.
AUD2_holistic.most_important_pipeline_weakness: Survivorship with NO terminal expected-value kill criterion: the pipeline must always emit a 'best survivor,' so a ~10-15%-win, components-likely-inert idea becomes the cycle's output. No stage rejects purely on low EV / not-worth-running.

consensus_note: Both Opus auditors independently reached the same verdict. The niche is REAL (0 fabrication, all arXiv IDs verified, genuine no-collision combination) but MARGINAL: its distinctive physics framing is likely non-load-bearing and its value is modest-incremental (~10-15% chance of a clean win vs strong baselines). It is an honest long-shot research SEED, worth a small ablation at most.

final_niche.name: GridFermi-PE (Fermi-Shell Positional Encoding)
final_niche.one_line: A transformer positional encoding fusing per-head learnable hexagonal-reciprocal-lattice wavevectors (grid-cell) with QUEST-style per-token query-norm concentration tuned to peak at each head's wavevector shell (Kohn 2k_F analogue); hypothesis: better length generalization than RoPE/ALiBi/FoPE.
final_niche.honest_status: legitimate but marginal long-shot seed; MODEST_INCREMENTAL; geometry likely decorative; recommended action = small bounded ablation (hexagonal-vs-generic, 2k_F-tuning-vs-none)
